captions.detailed: A classic casino slot machine featuring a dark red body, a rounded top marquee, and a central screen window showcasing three white spinning reels with colored symbols. Below the screen, there are two circular, light-colored push buttons housed in cylindrical guides and a dark grey cashbox door with a brass-colored knob at the bottom. The three reels spin continuously on a horizontal axis, the two front buttons translate prismatically along their vertical axes, and the lower cashbox door pivots open on a vertical side hinge.
captions.instruction: Create an articulated 3D model of a casino slot machine. The model must feature a main dark red cabinet with a rounded top header, a central display window housing three individual spinning reels, two functional push buttons below the window, and a hinged cashbox door on the lower front panel. Ensure the reels are set up for continuous rotation, the buttons for prismatic sliding, and the door for revolute rotation.
captions.factory: Construct the main cabinet using a base Box primitive combined with a top header made from a horizontal Cylinder cut in half. Model the central screen window by subtracting a rectangular opening from the front face. Create the three spinning reels as Cylinders rotated horizontally and place them inside the window cavity. Model the two spin buttons as small Cylinders nested inside slightly larger hollow cylindrical guides, and construct the cashbox door as a thin flat Box with a tiny Cylinder knob. Define continuous rotational joints for each of the three reels, prismatic joints for each of the two buttons, and a revolute joint along the side edge of the cashbox door.
